title: achillea ptarmica subsp. macrocephala
intro: Achillea ptarmica subsp. macrocephala, commonly known as Tansy or Large Head Tansy, is a perennial plant that belongs to the daisy family and is native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative and anti-anxiety effects. The health benefits of Achillea ptarmica subsp. macrocephala include its ability to act as a nervine tonic, helping to calm the nervous system and reduce symptoms of stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties.
